# 09 — UI & HUD

**Group:** the deliberately minimal HUD, the diegetic instruments that replace it, and every screen the
player actually opens.
**Items:** ~48
**Depends on:** the systems each screen reports on. Built alongside them, not before.

Systems: [ui](../systems/ui/README.md) · [gui direction](../game/gui.md) · [fonts](../game/fonts.md) ·
`roblox-ui` and `mobile` skills

---

## The rule that governs this whole group

> **If information belongs to the boat, show it on the boat. If it belongs to the player, show it on the HUD.**

So this group is unusual: **a large part of the work is in group 02**, as physical gauges. What is left on
screen is small on purpose. Banned by design: a permanent minimap, a giant quest list, a permanent boat
dashboard, large resource counters.

⚠️ **Mobile is not a later pass.** Both places are landscape-only with a DynamicThumbstick, which reserves
Roblox's own bottom-left quadrant for movement. Every layout below must avoid that rect and be measured in
the device emulator, not reasoned about. The `mobile` skill records four jobs lost in another project to
exactly this mistake.

## E. Design system — 12 items

Build this **first**. Every screen above depends on it, and ad-hoc styling is how UIs rot.

| Item | What it is | GB | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Colour tokens | The palette from visual-design.md as named constants | ❌ | code |
| Font roles | Body / instrument (technical) / display (condensed industrial) | ❌ | code |
| Type scale | Sizes that survive TextScaled on a phone | ❌ | code |
| Panel component | The base frame; one look, everywhere | ❌ | code |
| Button component | Including a ≥58px-preferred touch target rule | ❌ | code |
| Gauge component | Reusable dial for every physical instrument | ❌ | code |
| Bar / meter component | Hull, fuel, generator load | ❌ | code |
| List / row component | Inventory, storage, crew, parts | ❌ | code |
| Prompt component | Contextual interaction | ❌ | code |
| Toast / warning component | Temporary alerts | ❌ | code |
| StyleSheet setup | Studio UI Styling so theming is central | ❌ | code |
| **Safe-area handling** | Insets, notches, and the reserved thumbstick rect | ❌ | code |

---

## Suggested job split

1. **Design system** — E. *Nothing else in this group should start first.*
2. **Minimal HUD** — A, measured in the emulator against the reserved touch rects.
3. **Quick status overlay** — B, including the accessible mode.
4. **Radar screen** — C's radar plus F's sweep and interference. Pairs with feature 0002.
5. **Helm & power panels** — the rest of the instrument surfaces.
6. **Inventory & storage** — D's cargo screens; pairs with group 03.
7. **Chart & progression** — the map, sea-stage display, codex.
8. **End-of-run summary** — the reward screen; pairs with group 08.
9. **Polish pass** — F's needles, flicker, sounds, icons.

## Open questions

- **Which fonts actually exist** in the current Studio font list? The typography doc describes roles, not
  faces — verify before building the type scale.
- **How does a touch player use a gauge cluster** they must be close to? Tapping an instrument to open a
  readable overlay is the likely answer, and it needs designing, not assuming.
- **Is the radar its own screen or only the physical station?** Decision 0004 forbids a permanent minimap;
  a hold-to-view radar may be within the spirit or may not.
- **Do we support gamepad?** The UI rules say design for it from the start; that is a real cost.
